roots.origin: 拉丁语 carrus（四轮货车），借自高卢语；经古北法语 carre、西班牙语 cargar（装车）等分支入英语
roots.core_concept: a wheeled cart and what it takes on / 一辆载货的车，以及装上去的东西
roots.core_image: 一辆四轮车停在场上，货一件件往车板上码
roots.english_definition: wheeled cart, to convey by cart

roots.origin: 拉丁语 tradere（交付、移交），由 trans（越过）＋dare（给）构成；交出去的东西是好是坏，分出「传承」与「背卖」两支
roots.core_concept: handing a thing across into other hands / 把东西越过界交到别人手里
roots.core_image: 一样东西从这只手越过去，落进对面那只手

roots.origin: 希腊语 bainein（走、踏），其名词 basis 本义「踏脚处、立足点」，经拉丁语 basis 入英语；词根 id 用动词形 bainein，因 basis 本身是本批要收的单词，作 id 会产生自环边
roots.core_concept: the spot the foot comes down on, what everything above rests on / 脚落下的那一处，上面全靠它撑
roots.core_image: 脚踩实了那块石头，整个人的重量才敢压上去

roots.origin: 拉丁语 charta（纸莎草叶、纸）← 希腊语 khartēs（纸卷）；经意大利语 carta、法语 carte 分支入英语
roots.core_concept: a flat sheet that carries marks / 一张平面，用来承载写画的东西
roots.core_image: 一张硬纸铺开，上面画的线和字一目了然

roots.origin: 拉丁语 campus（平坦原野、operations 用的场地）；词根 id 加 -field 后缀，因 campus 本身是本批要收的单词，作 id 会产生自环边（照 edere-publish、ter-comparative 先例）
roots.core_concept: an open flat ground where things are staged / 一片摊开的平地，事在上头铺排
roots.core_image: 一片空旷平地，帐篷一排排扎开，中间留出走道

roots.origin: 拉丁语 circulus（小环）是 circus（圆圈）的指小形 ← 希腊语 kirkos（环）；circum（绕、环着）本是 circus 的宾格作副词用，故 circuit 一支也归此族
roots.core_concept: a line that comes round to where it began / 一条线绕回到起点
roots.core_image: 用绳拴住笔一转，笔尖回到落笔那一点，圈就合上了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 battuere（击打、拍击），通俗拉丁语里取代 caedere 成常用词；英语 battle、combat、debate 均自此支
roots.core_concept: blow answering blow between two sides / 两边一下接一下地对打
roots.core_image: 两只手轮着往下砸，一下接一下，谁也不肯先停

roots.origin: 拉丁语 canalis（水槽、管道）← canna（芦苇、管）← 希腊语 kanna；芦苇中空成管，故引申为凡中空可通之物
roots.core_concept: a hollow tube that something runs through / 一根中空的管，东西顺着它走
roots.core_image: 一截芦苇折断，里头是空的，水一倒就顺着流出去

roots.origin: 拉丁语 caput（头、首要之处）；经古法语 chief 一支入英语，又经晚期拉丁语 capitale（首要财产）派出 cattle
roots.core_concept: the head, hence whatever stands at the top / 头，引申为居首的那一个
roots.core_image: 一群人里那个头往前一伸，别人的目光跟着转过去

roots.origin: 拉丁语 citare（唤来、催动）是 ciere（使动起来）的反复体；本义是把人或话「叫到面前来」
roots.core_concept: calling a thing up so it stands before you / 把某样东西唤到眼前来
roots.core_image: 一声招呼，本来不在场的那个被叫到跟前站着

roots.origin: 希腊语 klinein（使倾斜、斜靠）；klima（地带，本指日照斜角）、klimax（梯子，一级级斜上去）、klinē（卧床，斜靠之处）皆由此出
roots.core_concept: leaning at a slant, and what follows from the tilt / 斜着倾靠，以及这个斜度带来的结果
roots.core_image: 一块板一头垫高，东西顺着那道斜面往下滑

roots.origin: 拉丁语 bulla（水泡、圆凸的铅封）；封在文书上的铅印是圆的，故文书本身也叫 bulla，英语 bulletin 由此；圆球一支经法语 boule 派出 bullet
roots.core_concept: a small round swelling, and what is sealed or shaped by it / 一个圆凸的小物，及由它封定或成形之物
roots.core_image: 一枚圆铅印按在纸角上，凸起来一小块

words.root_logic: carrus（四轮货车）→ 带轮子载人载物的那种车
words.origin: 古北法语 carre ← 拉丁语 carrus（四轮货车）
words.native_definition: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels
words.core_concept: the wheeled box one gets into and is taken along in – 坐进去、被它带着走的那个带轮子的箱
words.core_image: 四个轮子撑着一个铁壳，人坐进去合上门
semantic_expansions: 汽车：带轮载人的那种车
车厢：列车上同样带轮的一节
words.recall_hint: carrus（四轮货车）→ 带轮子载人载物的车

words.root_logic: carrus（货车）→ carriare（用车运）→ 把东西带着走
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 carier（用车运）← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus（货车）
words.native_definition: to hold something and take it with you
words.core_concept: taking a load along instead of leaving it where it lay – 把货带着走，而不是留在原地
words.core_image: 他把箱子抱起来，一路没放下过
semantic_expansions: 搬运/携带：把东西带着走
载运：车船同样把货带着走
words.recall_hint: carrus（货车）→ carriare（用车运）→ 带着走

words.root_logic: carry（用车运）+ -age → 供载运的那辆车，及载运这件事
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 cariage ← carier ← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus
words.native_definition: a vehicle pulled by horses; a railway coach; the act of carrying
words.core_concept: the box on wheels made to be pulled – 造出来专供人拉着走的那个带轮的厢
words.core_image: 两匹马在前头，后面那个厢一晃一晃跟着
semantic_expansions: 马车/车厢：供载运的那个带轮的厢
运输：把货带着走这件事本身
words.recall_hint: carry（用车运）+ -age → 供载运的车及其事

words.root_logic: carry（带着走）+ -er → 负责把东西带着走的人或物
words.origin: 英语 carrier，来自 carry ← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus
words.native_definition: a person or thing that transports something; one who spreads a disease
words.core_concept: whatever the load is handed to for the journey – 把货交给它、由它带走的那个
words.core_image: 包裹交到那人手上，第二天出现在另一座城
examples: The carrier delivered it by noon.
semantic_expansions: 运送者/承运人：受托把货带走的那方
带菌者：同样是被病带着走的那个载体
words.recall_hint: carry（带着走）+ -er → 负责带走的那个

words.root_logic: carrus（货车）→ 西班牙语 cargar（装车）→ 装在车船上的那批货
words.origin: 西班牙语 cargo（装载物）← cargar（装车）← 通俗拉丁语 carricare ← carrus
words.native_definition: the goods carried by a ship, plane, or truck
words.core_concept: what fills the hold once the loading is done – 装完之后填满舱里的那批东西
words.core_image: 舱盖掀开，底下一层层码到顶都是箱子
examples: The ship carried a cargo of grain.
semantic_expansions: 货物/载货：装在车船上被带走的那批东西
words.recall_hint: carrus（货车）→ cargar（装车）→ 装上去的货

words.root_logic: carrus（车）→ carraria（车道）→ 跑道 → 一个人走过的那条职业道
words.origin: 法语 carrière（跑马道）← 意大利语 carriera ← 通俗拉丁语 carraria（车道）← carrus
words.native_definition: the series of jobs a person has over their working life
words.core_concept: the track laid for wheels, and by extension the course one runs – 给车轮铺出的那条道，引申为人一路跑下来的路线
words.core_image: 车辙压出两道印子，后来的车都顺着这两道走
examples: She had a long career in law.
semantic_expansions: 职业/事业：一个人顺着走下来的那条道
生涯：这条道从头到尾的整段
words.recall_hint: carrus（车）→ carraria（车道）→ 人走的职业道

words.root_logic: carrus（货车）→ carricare（装车）→ 把担子压上去 → 收费、指控、充电
words.origin: 古法语 chargier（装载）← 通俗拉丁语 carricare（装车）← carrus（货车）
words.native_definition: to ask a price; to accuse formally; to put electricity into
words.core_concept: loading a weight onto someone or something – 把一份分量压到人或物身上
words.core_image: 货往车上一压，车轴吃住了那个重量
examples: They charge ten pounds for entry.
semantic_expansions: 收费：把价钱这份分量压给顾客
指控：把罪名压到人身上
充电：把电这份量压进电池
冲锋：把整个人的势压向前
words.recall_hint: carrus（货车）→ carricare（装车）→ 把分量压上去

words.root_logic: trad（交付）+ -ition → 一代代交下来的那套 → 传统
words.origin: 拉丁语 traditio（交付、口传）← tradere（交付）← trans＋dare
words.native_definition: a custom or belief passed down over generations
words.core_concept: what each generation puts into the next pair of hands – 每一代交到下一双手里的那份
words.core_image: 老人把那套做法一样样交给儿子，儿子照着又教给孙子
examples: The town keeps its old traditions.
semantic_expansions: 传统/惯例：一代代交下来、照着做的那套
传承：交这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: trad（交付）+ -ition → 一代代交下来的那套

words.root_logic: trait（交付）+ -or（人）→ 把自己一方交出去的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 traitre ← 拉丁语 traditor（交付者、叛卖者）← tradere
words.native_definition: a person who betrays their country or friends
words.core_concept: the one who hands his own side over to the other – 把自己这边交到对面手里的那个
words.core_image: 他把名册递了出去，第二天册上的人一个个被带走
examples: He was executed as a traitor.
semantic_expansions: 叛徒/卖国者：把自己一方交到对面手里的那个人
words.recall_hint: trait（交付）+ -or（人）→ 把自己一方交出去的人

words.root_logic: treas（交付）+ -on → 把国家交出去这桩罪
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 treisoun ← 拉丁语 traditio（交付、叛卖）← tradere
words.native_definition: the crime of betraying one's own country
words.core_concept: the act of handing one's own country across – 把自己的国交出去这个行为
words.core_image: 图纸从抽屉里取出，越过边境线递到了对面
examples: Such an act amounts to treason.
semantic_expansions: 叛国罪：把自己的国交出去这桩罪
背叛：同一个交出去的动作，泛用
words.recall_hint: treas（交付）+ -on → 把国交出去这桩罪

words.root_logic: be-（加强）+ tray（交付）→ 把托付之物交给外人 → 背叛；引申为无意露出
words.origin: 中古英语 betrayen，由 be-＋古法语 trair ← 拉丁语 tradere（交付）
words.native_definition: to be disloyal to someone; to reveal something unintentionally
words.core_concept: handing over what was entrusted to you – 把托付给自己的东西交了出去
words.core_image: 钥匙本是托他保管，他却把它递到了外人手上
semantic_expansions: 背叛：把托付之物交给外人
泄露：把不该交的消息交了出去
流露：神情不自觉把心里的事交了出来
words.recall_hint: be-（加强）+ tray（交付）→ 把托付之物交出去

words.root_logic: basis（踏脚处）→ 底下承重的那一处 → 底座、基地
words.origin: 古法语 bas ← 拉丁语 basis ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）← bainein（踏）
words.native_definition: the lowest part that supports something; a centre of operations
words.core_concept: the part everything above puts its weight on – 上面所有重量都压在它身上的那一层
words.core_image: 柱子底下那块方石承着整根柱，抽掉它上面就塌
examples: The base of the lamp is heavy.
They returned to base at dusk.
semantic_expansions: 底部/基础：上面重量全压在它身上的那一层
基地：一切行动的落脚与出发之处
words.recall_hint: basis（踏脚处）→ 底下承重的那一层

words.root_logic: basis（踏脚处）→ 论证或安排所立足的那一点
words.origin: 拉丁语 basis ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）← bainein（踏）
words.native_definition: the facts or ideas from which something is developed
words.core_concept: the footing an argument stands on – 一番道理踩着立住的那一点
words.core_image: 他先把那个前提摆稳，后面的话才踩得住
examples: What is the basis of your claim?
We meet on a weekly basis.
semantic_expansions: 基础：整套说法立足的那一点
根据/依据：拿它当立足点来论证
words.recall_hint: basis（踏脚处）→ 论证立足的那一点

words.root_logic: base（底层）+ -ic → 属于最底那一层的 → 基本的
words.origin: 英语 basic，来自 base ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）
words.native_definition: forming the simplest and most necessary part of something
words.core_concept: the layer nothing else can be put under – 底下再没有别的一层了
words.core_image: 把上面几层都揭掉，剩下这层再往下就没有了
examples: The room has only basic furniture.
semantic_expansions: 基本的/必需的：底下再没有一层可揭的
初级的：从最底那层学起的
words.recall_hint: base（底层）+ -ic → 属于最底那一层

words.root_logic: base（底部）+ -ment → 房子最底下那一层
words.origin: 英语 basement，来自 base ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）
words.native_definition: the floor of a building that is below ground level
words.core_concept: the storey the whole house stands on, dug into the ground – 整栋房子踩着的那一层，埋在地里
words.core_image: 顺楼梯往下走到底，头顶就是一楼的地板
examples: They store boxes in the basement.
semantic_expansions: 地下室/底层：整栋房子踩着的、埋在地里那一层
words.recall_hint: base（底部）+ -ment → 房子最底那一层

words.root_logic: base（垒、踏脚处）+ ball（球）→ 绕垒跑的那种球赛
words.origin: 英语复合词 base＋ball；base ← 希腊语 basis（踏脚处）
words.native_definition: a game in which players hit a ball and run round four bases
words.core_concept: the game named after the spots the runner must step on – 以跑者必须踩到的那几处得名的球赛
words.core_image: 打完那一棒他就跑，脚一个个点过场上那四块垫子
semantic_expansions: 棒球：以跑者要踩的那几处（垒）得名的球赛
words.recall_hint: base（垒）+ ball（球）→ 绕垒跑的球赛

words.root_logic: charta（纸）→ 裁成小张的硬纸片
words.origin: 法语 carte ← 意大利语 carta ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）← 希腊语 khartēs
words.native_definition: a small piece of stiff paper used for messages, games, or identity
words.core_concept: the palm-sized stiff sheet you hand over or hold – 递出去或攥在手里那张巴掌大的硬纸
words.core_image: 他从钱包里抽出一张硬硬的小方片，递到柜台上
examples: She sent me a birthday card.
semantic_expansions: 卡片：裁成小张的硬纸
纸牌：印了花色供玩的那种小张
证件：印了身份信息的那一张
words.recall_hint: charta（纸）→ 裁成小张的硬纸片

words.root_logic: charta（纸）→ 画上线条数据的那张纸 → 图表、海图
words.origin: 法语 charte ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）
words.native_definition: a sheet showing information as lines, figures, or a map
words.core_concept: the sheet whose marks let you read a whole situation at a glance – 靠纸上的线条一眼看出全局的那张
words.core_image: 墙上贴的那张纸画着起落的折线，谁走过都抬头看一眼
semantic_expansions: 图表：把数据画成线条的那张纸
海图：画着航路水深的那张
排行榜：把名次排成表的那张
words.recall_hint: charta（纸）→ 画上线条数据的那张纸

words.root_logic: chart（纸）+ -er → 写明权利的那份正式文书；动词指按约包租
words.origin: 古法语 chartre ← 拉丁语 chartula（小纸片、文书）← charta（纸）
words.native_definition: a formal document stating rights; to hire a vehicle for exclusive use
words.core_concept: the sheet whose words bind, once sealed – 一旦盖了印，纸上的字就约束住人
words.core_image: 羊皮纸上盖了红印，从此城里的人按那上头写的办
examples: The city received its charter in 1215.
semantic_expansions: 宪章/特许证：写明权利、盖印生效的那份文书
包租：照文书约定独家使用车船
words.recall_hint: chart（纸）+ -er → 写明权利、盖印生效的文书

words.root_logic: carta（纸）+ -one（大）→ 大张硬纸上的草图 → 漫画、动画
words.origin: 意大利语 cartone（厚纸板、草图）← carta ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）
words.native_definition: a humorous drawing; a film made from drawings
words.core_concept: the big sheet a drawing is worked out on before anything else – 别的都还没动，先在大张纸上画出来的那个
words.core_image: 一大张厚纸摊在桌上，草稿一格一格画满了
semantic_expansions: 漫画：画在纸上、供人一看就笑的那种图
动画片：由这类画一格格连成的影片
words.recall_hint: carta（纸）+ -one（大）→ 大张纸上的草图

words.root_logic: campus（原野）→ 在野地上扎下的临时住处
words.origin: 法语 camp ← 意大利语 campo ← 拉丁语 campus（原野）
words.native_definition: a place with tents or huts where people stay temporarily
words.core_concept: cloth and poles set up on open ground, meant to come down again – 在空地上搭起来、还要拆走的那些棚帐
words.core_image: 空地上支起十几顶帐篷，绳子一头钉进土里
examples: They set up camp by the river.
semantic_expansions: 营地/露营：在野地搭起、还要拆走的临时住处
阵营：同一块地上聚起来的那一伙人
words.recall_hint: campus（原野）→ 野地上扎的临时住处

words.root_logic: campus（原野）→ 学校所占的那整片地
words.origin: 拉丁语 campus（原野），18 世纪美国普林斯顿用它指校地，遂成此义
words.native_definition: the grounds and buildings of a university or college
words.core_concept: the whole stretch of ground a school spreads over – 一所学校摊开来占住的那整片地
words.core_image: 从图书馆走到食堂要穿过两片草坪，全在同一圈围墙里
semantic_expansions: 校园/校区：一所学校摊开占住的那整片地
words.recall_hint: campus（原野）→ 学校占住的那整片地

words.root_logic: campagna（旷野）→ 军队开到野地上打的那一仗 → 战役；引申为有组织的行动
words.origin: 法语 campagne ← 意大利语 campagna（旷野）← 拉丁语 campus（原野）
words.native_definition: a planned series of actions to achieve a goal, military or public
words.core_concept: a run of moves carried out on open ground toward one end – 在开阔地上一步步铺排、朝一个目标去的那串动作
words.core_image: 队伍开到野地上驻下，一步步照计划往前推
examples: She ran a campaign for clean water.
semantic_expansions: 战役：军队在野地上铺排的那一仗
运动/竞选活动：同样有组织、朝一个目标推的那串行动
words.recall_hint: campagna（旷野）→ 野地上铺排的那一仗

words.root_logic: campio（在场上格斗的人）← campus（场地）→ 场上胜出的那个 → 冠军
words.origin: 古法语 champion ← 晚期拉丁语 campio（角斗者）← 拉丁语 campus（场地）
words.native_definition: a person who wins a competition; one who fights for a cause
words.core_concept: the one left standing on the field when the others are done – 场上比到最后还立着的那个
words.core_image: 场地中间只剩一个人站着，四周的人开始鼓掌
semantic_expansions: 冠军：场上比到最后立着的那个
拥护者：同样在场上替某一方出战的人
words.recall_hint: campio（场上格斗者）← campus（场地）→ 胜出者

words.root_logic: circulus（小环）→ 一圈闭合的线，及圈起来的那片
words.origin: 古法语 cercle ← 拉丁语 circulus（小环）← circus（圆圈）
words.native_definition: a round shape whose edge is everywhere the same distance from the centre
words.core_concept: the closed line that ends exactly where it started – 终点正落在起点上的那条闭线
words.core_image: 笔尖绕一圈回到原处，纸上留下一条合起来的线
examples: Draw a circle on the board.
She has a small circle of friends.
semantic_expansions: 圆：终点落回起点的那条闭线
圈子：像那条线一样围起来的一小群人
环绕：沿着那条线走一遍
words.recall_hint: circulus（小环）→ 终点落回起点的闭线

words.root_logic: circul（小环）+ -ar（…的）→ 圆形的；也指绕回原处的（论证）
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 circularis（属于环的）← circulus
words.native_definition: shaped like a circle; moving round; returning to the start
words.core_concept: of the form that leads back to where it set out – 属于那种走回原处的形状
words.core_image: 跑道绕了一整圈，起跑线和终点线是同一条
examples: The table has a circular top.
semantic_expansions: 圆形的：形如那条闭线
循环的：绕一圈回到原处
通知：绕着一圈人依次传阅的那张
words.recall_hint: circul（小环）+ -ar → 形如闭线、绕回原处

words.root_logic: circus（圆圈）→ 圆形场地 → 在圆场里演的那种班子
words.origin: 拉丁语 circus（圆圈、圆形竞技场）← 希腊语 kirkos（环）
words.native_definition: a travelling show with acrobats and animals, performed in a ring
words.core_concept: the round pit the audience sits all the way around – 观众围满一整圈的那个圆场
words.core_image: 帐篷中间空出一个圆场，看台把它整整围了一圈
semantic_expansions: 马戏团：在圆场里演出的那个班子
圆形广场：几条路绕成一圈的那处场地
words.recall_hint: circus（圆圈）→ 圆形场地 → 圆场里的班子

words.root_logic: circum（绕，circus 的宾格作副词）+ it（ire 行）→ 绕行一周 → 回路、巡回
words.origin: 古法语 circuit ← 拉丁语 circuitus（绕行）← circum（绕）＋ire（行）；主根是 ire（行），但 circum 出自 circus，故归此族并在此注明
words.native_definition: a closed path, especially one electricity flows round; a regular tour
words.core_concept: the way that must close on itself for anything to move along it – 必须首尾接上、才走得通的那条路
words.core_image: 线从这头接到那头再绕回来，灯才亮起来
semantic_expansions: 电路：首尾接上才通电的那条闭路
环线/巡回：同样绕一圈回到原处的路线
words.recall_hint: circum（绕）+ it（行）→ 绕行一周、首尾接上

words.root_logic: battuere（击打）→ battualia（操练、交手）→ 两军对打的那一场
words.origin: 古法语 bataille ← 晚期拉丁语 battualia（击剑操练）← battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: a fight between armed forces; a struggle to achieve something
words.core_concept: two sides trading blows until one gives way – 两边对着打，直到一方撑不住
words.core_image: 两队人在坡上互相冲了几个来回，谁也没退
examples: She fought a long battle with illness.
semantic_expansions: 战斗/战役：两军对着打的那一场
斗争：把这场对打用在非武力的事上
words.recall_hint: battuere（击打）→ 两边对打的那一场

words.root_logic: com-（相对）+ bat（打）→ 面对面对打
words.origin: 法语 combat ← combattre ← 晚期拉丁语 combattere ← com＋battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: fighting between armed forces; to try to stop something bad
words.core_concept: the two standing face to face, each blow met by another – 两人面对面站定，一下换一下
words.core_image: 两人正面站着，拳头一来一回，没人侧身躲开
semantic_expansions: 战斗/搏斗：面对面对打
对抗：把这股对打之力用在抑制某事上
words.recall_hint: com-（相对）+ bat（打）→ 面对面对打

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ bate（打）→ 用话往下打 → 辩论
words.origin: 古法语 debatre（争辩）← de＋batre ← 晚期拉丁语 battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: a formal discussion where opposing views are argued
words.core_concept: blows traded in words instead of fists – 打的是话，不是拳头
words.core_image: 两人隔着讲台一句接一句往回顶，谁也不肯松口
examples: The debate ran for three hours.
semantic_expansions: 辩论/争论：用话一句接一句地对打
讨论：同一动作缓和下来，只交换看法
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ bate（打）→ 用话往下打

words.root_logic: canalis（水槽）→ 人工挖出让水通行的那条道
words.origin: 拉丁语 canalis（水槽、管道）← canna（芦管）
words.native_definition: a long channel dug for boats or for carrying water
words.core_concept: the trench cut so water has one path and no other – 挖出来只许水走这一条的沟
words.core_image: 两岸砌得笔直，水面一路平着延到看不见的地方
examples: Boats pass through the canal daily.
semantic_expansions: 运河/沟渠：挖出让水通行的那条道
管道：体内同样中空可通的那种道
words.recall_hint: canalis（水槽）→ 挖出让水通行的那条道

words.root_logic: canalis（管道）经古法语 chanel → 水流经过的那条道；引申为传递的路子
words.origin: 古法语 chanel ← 拉丁语 canalis（水槽、管道）
words.native_definition: a passage water flows along; a band for broadcasting; a way of doing something
words.core_concept: the groove that decides where the flow may go – 决定水往哪儿走的那道槽
words.core_image: 石板上凿出一道浅槽，水只能顺着这道往下淌
examples: The Channel separates England and France.
semantic_expansions: 海峡：两地之间供水通行的那条道
频道：信号顺着走的那条道
途径：办事所走的那条道
words.recall_hint: canalis（管道）→ 决定流向的那道槽

words.root_logic: canna（管）+ -one（大）→ 一根大管子 → 火炮
words.origin: 法语 canon ← 意大利语 cannone（大管）← canna（芦管）← 拉丁语
words.native_definition: a large heavy gun that fires solid balls
words.core_concept: the oversized tube that sends its load out one end – 一根粗大的管，装的东西从一头轰出去
words.core_image: 铜管架在木架上，粗到能塞进拳头，一头对着城墙
examples: Old cannons line the fort wall.
semantic_expansions: 大炮/火炮：一根粗大的管，装的东西从一头轰出去
words.recall_hint: canna（管）+ -one（大）→ 一根大管子

words.root_logic: caput（头）经古法语 chief → 一群人里居首的那个
words.origin: 古法语 chief（头、首领）← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: the leader of a group; most important
words.core_concept: the one the others look to before acting – 别人动手前先看的那一个
words.core_image: 帐篷里众人说着话，一齐朝上座那人望过去
semantic_expansions: 首领：一群人里居首的那个
主要的/首席的：诸事里排在头位的
words.recall_hint: caput（头）→ 一群人里居首的那个

words.root_logic: chief（首领）的法语后期形 → 厨房里居首的那个 → 主厨
words.origin: 法语 chef（de cuisine，厨房之长）← 古法语 chief ← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: a professional cook, especially the one in charge of a kitchen
words.core_concept: the one whose word settles what leaves the kitchen – 菜出不出得了门，由他一句话定
words.core_image: 灶台后那人一抬手，几个帮手同时停下等着听
examples: The chef prepared a special menu.
She trained as a chef in Paris.
semantic_expansions: 主厨/厨师长：厨房里居首、说话作数的那个
words.recall_hint: chief（首领）法语后期形 → 厨房之长

words.root_logic: capitale（首要财产）→ 旧时最值钱的家产就是牛 → 牛群
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 catel（财产）← 晚期拉丁语 capitale（首要财产）← caput（头）；英语 capital（资本）同出此支，牛作旧时首要家产故得此名
words.native_definition: cows and bulls kept on a farm
words.core_concept: what used to count as a household's chief wealth, counted by the head – 旧时算作一家首要财产、按头来数的那些
words.core_image: 栏里十几头挤在一处，主人清早数一遍才放心
examples: The cattle grazed by the river.
He keeps forty head of cattle.
semantic_expansions: 牛/牲畜：旧时算作首要家产、按头计数的那些
words.recall_hint: capitale（首要财产）→ 旧时最值钱的家产即牛

words.root_logic: citare（唤来）→ 把别人的话唤到眼前作凭据 → 引用
words.origin: 拉丁语 citare（唤来、传唤）← ciere（使动起来）
words.native_definition: to quote a source as evidence; to summon to court
words.core_concept: calling another's words up to stand as witness – 把别人说过的话叫到跟前当证人
words.core_image: 他翻开书按住那一行，念出来给在座的人听
examples: He was cited to appear in court.
semantic_expansions: 引用/引证：把别人的话唤到眼前作凭据
传唤：把人唤到庭前
words.recall_hint: citare（唤来）→ 把话唤到眼前作凭据

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ cite（唤动）→ 把里头的劲唤出来 → 使激动
words.origin: 拉丁语 excitare（唤起、激发）← ex＋citare（唤动）
words.native_definition: to make someone feel eager or stirred up
words.core_concept: calling out the energy that was sitting still inside – 把本来静着的那股劲唤出来
words.core_image: 话音刚落，屋里人一下都坐直了，声音也高了
semantic_expansions: 使激动/激起：把静着的劲唤出来
刺激：同一动作用在感官或神经上
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ cite（唤动）→ 把里头的劲唤出来

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ cite（唤来）→ 把记住的话再唤出来 → 背诵
words.origin: 拉丁语 recitare（朗读、背诵）← re＋citare（唤来）
words.native_definition: to say aloud something learned by heart
words.core_concept: calling the words up again from memory, out loud – 把记下的话再唤出来，说给人听
words.core_image: 他闭着眼把整段说完，一个字没停顿
examples: She recited the poem from memory.
semantic_expansions: 背诵/朗诵：把记下的话再唤出来说给人听
列举：把各项一件件唤出来点过
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ cite（唤来）→ 把记住的话再唤出来

words.root_logic: klima（地带）← klinein（倾斜）→ 日照斜角不同分出的地带 → 一地长年的天候
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 clima（地带）← 希腊语 klima（倾斜、地带）← klinein（倾斜）；古人按日照入射的斜角划分地带，故此词本指「斜度」
words.native_definition: the usual weather conditions of an area over many years
words.core_concept: what the sun's slant onto one stretch of ground settles into over years – 日头斜照一地，年复一年定下来的那副样子
words.core_image: 同一片地上，年年都是那几个月潮、那几个月干
examples: There is a climate of distrust.
semantic_expansions: 气候：日照斜度定下的、一地长年的天候
风气：一处长期形成的那种氛围
words.recall_hint: klima（斜度、地带）← klinein（倾斜）→ 长年天候

words.root_logic: klimax（梯子）← klinein（斜靠）→ 一级级斜上去的顶端 → 高潮
words.origin: 希腊语 klimax（梯子）← klinein（斜靠、倾斜）
words.native_definition: the most intense or important point of something
words.core_concept: the last rung of a ladder that leans up and stops – 斜靠上去的梯子，最后那一级
words.core_image: 一级一级往上，到最上面那级再没有了，人就停在那儿
examples: The film builds to a climax.
semantic_expansions: 高潮/顶点：斜梯一级级上去、最后那一级
words.recall_hint: klimax（梯子）← klinein（斜靠）→ 最后那一级

words.root_logic: klinē（卧床）← klinein（斜靠）→ 在床边诊治 → 诊所
words.origin: 法语 clinique ← 希腊语 klinikē（床边医术）← klinē（卧床）← klinein（斜靠）
words.native_definition: a place where people go for medical treatment or advice
words.core_concept: the room built around the bed a patient leans back on – 围着病人斜靠的那张床设起来的屋
words.core_image: 一排床挨墙摆着，穿白衣的人挨床看过去
examples: She works at a dental clinic.
semantic_expansions: 诊所/门诊：围着病人斜靠的床设起来的诊治之处
words.recall_hint: klinē（卧床）← klinein（斜靠）→ 床边诊治之处

words.root_logic: bulla（铅封文书）→ bullettino（小文书）→ 简短公告
words.origin: 法语 bulletin ← 意大利语 bullettino（小文告）← bulla（盖铅封的文书）← 拉丁语
words.native_definition: a short official statement of news
words.core_concept: the sealed slip put up so all may read the same words – 盖了印贴出来、让众人读到同一句话的那张
words.core_image: 墙上钉着一张短短的纸，底下按了印，路过的人都停下看
examples: A bulletin was issued at noon.
semantic_expansions: 公告/简报：盖印贴出、让众人读到的那张短文
新闻快报：同样简短、随时发出的那种
words.recall_hint: bulla（铅封文书）→ 简短公告

words.root_logic: boule（球）+ -ette（小）→ 小圆球 → 枪弹
words.origin: 法语 boulette（小球）← boule（球）← 拉丁语 bulla（圆泡）
words.native_definition: a small piece of metal fired from a gun
words.core_concept: the little round slug that leaves the barrel – 从枪管里出去的那颗小圆粒
words.core_image: 掌心里几颗黄铜色的小圆粒，一头是尖的
semantic_expansions: 子弹/弹丸：从枪管出去的那颗小圆粒
words.recall_hint: boule（球）+ -ette（小）→ 小圆球 → 枪弹

words.root_logic: boule（球）→ bowl（滚球）+ -ing → 滚球撞瓶的那种玩法
words.origin: 英语 bowling，来自 bowl（滚球）← 法语 boule（球）← 拉丁语 bulla（圆泡）
words.native_definition: a game in which a heavy ball is rolled to knock down pins
words.core_concept: the heavy round thing sent rolling down a lane – 顺着一条道滚出去的那个沉圆物
words.core_image: 一个沉沉的圆球贴地滚出去，尽头一排木柱哗啦倒了
semantic_expansions: 保龄球/滚球游戏：把沉圆物滚出去撞倒木柱的那种玩法
words.recall_hint: boule（球）→ bowl（滚球）→ 滚球撞瓶的玩法
